security_audit.summary: All 293 static findings were adjudicated as false positives. The scanner primarily matched Markdown formatting, documentation examples, bounded local maintenance commands, and the declared Paperclip API helper. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The artifact helper accepts its API base URL from the environment.
remediation.suggestion: Document that operators must provide a trusted Paperclip API URL and prefer HTTPS for remote deployments.

remediation.issue: Fresh-start examples use recursive deletion of the Paperclip database directory.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the stop-server warning adjacent to every reset command and offer a confirmation-oriented CLI reset command when available.

content.value_statement: Teams need a consistent way to coordinate agent work, approvals, and task progress. This skill guides Paperclip API workflows for assignments, updates, routines, and deliverables.
actual_capabilities: Check the current agent identity and assigned Paperclip tasks.
Check out tasks and update their status with auditable run headers.
Read task context, comments, approvals, and dependency information.
Create subtasks, delegate work, and record blockers.
Create and manage recurring Paperclip routines.
Upload a selected workspace artifact to the current task and create a work product.
limitations: Works only with a configured and authorized Paperclip control plane.
Coordinates work but does not perform domain work such as coding or research.
Requires Paperclip environment variables or operator configuration for authenticated API calls.
Artifact uploads send only the file explicitly selected by the operator or workflow.

use_cases.title: Run an agent heartbeat
use_cases.description: Review assigned tasks, claim the next task, record progress, and leave a clear final status.

use_cases.title: Manage approval workflows
use_cases.description: Review a Paperclip approval, update linked tasks, and explain the decision in task comments.

use_cases.title: Publish a deliverable
use_cases.description: Upload a selected report, image, or video to a Paperclip task and create a reviewable work product.

prompt_templates.title: Check my assignments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Paperclip to check my current assignments and summarize the highest-priority task.

prompt_templates.title: Update task progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Paperclip to update my current task with completed work, remaining work, and the correct status.

prompt_templates.title: Create a dependent subtask
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Paperclip to create a subtask for the follow-up work, link it to the current task, and mark the current task blocked if needed.

prompt_templates.title: Complete an approval follow-up
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Paperclip to review the active approval, assess its linked tasks, and update each task with the appropriate audited disposition.

output: Next action: Review the latest comments and publish the draft for approval

output_examples.input: Upload the final design review file to my task.
output: Work product: created and ready for review

output_examples.input: Create a follow-up task for testing.
output: Recorded the dependency on the current task

best_practices: Use the injected Paperclip API URL and key. Never place credentials in prompts, comments, or logs.
Check out a task before starting work and include the Paperclip run ID on state-changing requests.
Record a clear status, blocker, or reviewer path before ending a heartbeat.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for coding, research, or other domain work outside Paperclip coordination.
Do not retry a checkout conflict or take a task owned by another agent.
Do not upload files that were not selected as task deliverables.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Paperclip tasks, comments, approvals, routines, agent coordination, and work products.

faq.question: Does it perform the assigned engineering work?
faq.answer: No. It coordinates Paperclip work. Use a suitable skill or tool for the domain work itself.

faq.question: What credentials does it need?
faq.answer: It uses Paperclip environment variables supplied by the adapter or configured by an authorized operator.

faq.question: Can it update task status?
faq.answer: Yes. It can check out tasks and record progress, blockers, review requests, and completion.

faq.question: Can it upload artifacts?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper uploads an explicitly selected workspace file to the configured Paperclip task.

faq.question: How are recurring tasks handled?
faq.answer: The skill includes guidance for creating and managing Paperclip routines with approved schedules.
